cd probe
logos build -O=3 -o $WORK/probe$GOEXE .

-- probe/go.mod --
module example.com/nosplitrepro

go 1.27
-- probe/main.go --
package main

import "os"

type Entry struct {
	Name string
}

func (e *Entry) Unmarshal(src []byte, n int) {
	if n <= 0 || n > len(src) {
		return
	}
	buf := make([]byte, n)
	copy(buf, src[:n])
	e.Name = string(buf)
}

//go:nosplit
func (e *Entry) CopyIn(src []byte, n int) int {
	e.Unmarshal(src, n)
	return len(e.Name)
}

var sink func(*Entry, []byte, int) int = (*Entry).CopyIn

func main() {
	var e Entry
	println(sink(&e, []byte("hello"), len(os.Args)))
}
